svg.title: Fig. 205(b) — Four tuning forks in unison: Do – Mi – Sol – Do, ratios 4 : 5 : 6 : 8
svg.desc: Redrawn from Robert C. Yates, A Handbook on Curves and Their Properties (1947), Fig. 205(b), page 231. Section: trigonometric.

g.data-text: The four waves have the frequencies 4, 5, 6, 8 (Do, Mi, Sol, high Do) and the same amplitude.
g.text: Four Tuning Forks in Unison—Do-Mi-Sol-Do in ratios 4 : 5 : 6 : 8.

g.data-text: The composite wave −(sin 4t + sin 5t + sin 6t + sin 8t) over four and a half periods of the common period 2π: the tall spikes mark the moments when the four waves reinforce each other.
